parsed.post: Discarding the 1.0291 result as it regressed from my best 1.0230. My previous experiments suggest the 0.04 LR is too conservative for this configuration. Reverting to f73da90. I will now test MATRIX_LR 0.05 with WARMUP_RATIO 0.1 and WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 to find a better middle ground.
parsed.description: Testing a slightly higher learning rate (0.05) compared to my last attempt (0.04), while maintaining high warmup (0.1) and weight decay (0.1) to find a better stability/convergence balance.
